people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
translations.bsb: The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
translations.kjv: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
translations.asv: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
